title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.55
summary: Complete menu styling and corrected button spacing, with Installer 1.0.50.

sections.heading: Consistent BlackLanturn menus
bullets: File Manager, Add-ons, Add-on Information and Event Log now share dark panels, readable text and clear cyan focus.
Native Add-ons category artwork follows your silver or smoked-glass icon choice.

sections.heading: Buttons that fit
bullets: Corrected confirmation, keyboard, add-on category and music playlist button spacing.
Improved installer result, log-upload and notification layouts, plus full-window text readers.
Updates included Up Next to 1.3.2 while preserving existing settings and recognizing update completion correctly.

sections.heading: Keep your complete setup
bullets: Use Update BlackLanturn to keep accounts, authorizations, playback settings, sources, saved data and other installed add-ons.
Both build editions and the installer include these fixes so later updates retain them.
